grids_and_layouts.philosophy: Control Room Grid for high density correlation. Tight gaps (gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.containers: Always pad containers with text content (p-6) to avoid collision.

surfaces.cards: Flat background matching theme exactly, 1px subtle border, rounded-lg (8px max).
surfaces.sidebar: Solid neutral background separating it from the main content area for administrative focus.

motion.hover: Lighter hue for active states, NOT darker. Explicitly set hover:text-*.

components_instructions.styling: Solid background for primary. Outline for secondary. Use clear focus:ring-2.
components_instructions.testing: MUST include data-testid format: kebab-case, role-based.

components_instructions.styling: Header: uppercase, text-xs, tracking-wider, muted text. Row: hover:bg-muted/50. Cells: align-middle, right-align numeric data.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure Normal Text has 4.5:1 ratio. Large text 3:1.
accessibility.malayalam_script: CRITICAL: Use 'leading-relaxed' to prevent ascender/descender cutoff in Malayalam names/locations.

image_urls.description: Kerala landscape at golden hour, serene and earthy, used for the main auth screen background.
Default avatar for member profile pictures in tables or profile views.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'next-themes' if not already installed, and configure ThemeProvider in App.jsx or Layout.jsx for light/dark toggle.
Inject the Google Fonts for 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' into index.html.
Replace the content of /app/frontend/src/index.css with the defined HSL variables in the :root and .dark classes.
Update /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js to include the exact font families and custom variables.
Update all 14 pages in /app/frontend/src/pages/ to apply the new layout grids, typography scales, and generous spacing.
Ensure the sidebar navigation explicitly highlights the active route using the primary color.
Convert recharts components to use CSS variables (var(--chart-1)) to adapt automatically to dark mode.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, form input, table row, and link across the app.
